1.w: “I was sought by those who did not ask; I was found by those who did not seek Me. I said, Behold me! Behold me!’ To a nation not calling on My Name.

2.w: I have spread out My hands all the day to a rebellious people, those walking a way not good, after their thoughts;

3.w: the people provoking Me to my face continually, offering sacrifices in the gardens and burning incense on the bricks,

4.w: sitting among the graves and spending nights in lookouts, those eating the flesh of swine and the broth of of abominations [in] their vessels;

5.w: those saying, ‘Keep yourself away; do not come near to me, for I am set apart [from] you’—these [are] smoke in My nostrils, a fire burning all the day!

6.w: Behold, it is written before My face, [and] I will not keep silent, but I will repay, and I will pay it back into their bosom,

7.w: your⁺ iniquities, and the iniquities of your⁺ fathers together.” YHWH has said. “Because they have burned incense on the mountains, and on the hills they have scorned Me, so I will measure out their wages first into their bosom.”

8.w: Thus says YHWH: “As when the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘You should not destroy it, for blessing [is]’ in it, so will I do for the sake of My servants, so as not to destroy them all.

9.w: And I will bring forth from Jacob a seed, and from Judah one inheriting My mountains; and My chosen ones will inherit it, and My servants will dwell there.

10.w: And Sharon will become as a habitation for the flock, and the Valley of Achor as a resting place for herds, for my people who have sought Me.

11.w: And you⁺ forsaking YHWH, those forgetful of My holy mountain, of those arranging a table for Gad, and those filling mixed wine for Meni—

12.w: and I will appoint you⁺ for the sword, and you⁺ will all bow down to the slaughter, because I called, and you⁺ did not answer; I spoke, and you⁺ did not hear; and you⁺ did evil in My eyes, and you⁺ chose that in which I do not take delight.”

13.w: Therefore thus says the Lord YHWH: “Behold, My servants will eat, and you⁺ will go hungry. Behold, My servants will drink, and you⁺ will go thirsty. Behold, My servants will be glad, and you⁺ will be put to shame.

14.w: Behold, My servants will sing out from goodness of heart, and you⁺ will cry out from pain of heart, and from a breaking of spirit you⁺ will wail.

15.w: And you⁺ will leave behind your⁺ name as a curse for My chosen ones—and the Lord YHWH will slay you!—And to His servants He will call out another name,

16.w: that one blessing himself in the land will bless himself by the God of truth, and the one swearing in the land will swear by the God of truth; for the former troubles will be forgotten, for they will be hidden from My eyes.

17.w: For behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth; and the former [things] will not be remembered, and they will not come up upon the heart.

18.w: But rather be glad and rejoice forever [and] ever [in] that which I am creating! For behold, I am creating Jerusalem as rejoicing and her people as joy.

19.w: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people; and will not be heard in her any longer the voice of weeping and the voice of crying out.

20.w: There will not be from there anymore an infant of days, or an elder who does not fulfill his days. For the youth will die a son of a hundred years, a son, and the one falling short of a hundred years [old] will be accursed.

21.w: And they build houses and dwell, and they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

22.w: And they will not build, and another dwell there; they will not plant, and another eat; for like the days of a tree [are] the days of My people, and the work of their hands my chosen ones will wear out.

23.w: They will not toil in vain, and they will not bring forth for disaster; for [they are] a seed blessed of YHWH—they and their offspring with them.

24.w: And it will come to pass that before they call, then I will answer; and [while] they are still speaking, then I will hear.

25.w: The wolf and the lamb will pasture as one, and the lion like the ox will eat straw—and the serpent, dust [is] its food! They will not cause harm and they will not destroy in all My holy” mountain, says YHWH.
